meta.title: Phillips County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Phillips County's 2026 appropriation ordinance, as sent to the Association of Arkansas Counties and filed with the state. We use the amounts the ordinance appropriates for each office and fund (each fund may spend up to 90% of its projected revenue). No transfers between funds are listed.
